content.text: {"headline":"Approve P0: no action needed. The disruption window (17:00-19:00) is predicted at 98.3% service level against an 80% target.","why":"The payments spike came from the UPI outage (P1 incident INC-20261027-4076), not a staffing problem. Absences and handle time are normal. For 17:00-19:00 the forecast with no changes is 98.3% overall, with payments at 97.3%, general at 99.5% and 0.3% abandons. That is well above target at zero extra cost. The rest of the day is forecast at 95.2%.","trade_offs":["P1 (lend 2 agents) and P2 (lend 3 agents plus callbacks) cost nothing extra, but their moves start at 19:00, after the window. They give the same 98.3% in the window. P1 changes rest-of-day by only +0.1 point (95.3%), and P2 is slightly worse (94.8%) while pulling staff from general.","P3 (1 agent plus chat deflection) gives the best rest-of-day figure at 96.3%, but costs INR 204 and pushes some customers to chat. The window result is the same 98.3%.","Doing nothing keeps general fully staffed, so there is no risk to the other queue."],"watch":"These forecasts assume the UPI outage demand settles. If payments volume climbs back toward the 13:30 level (201 calls, 2.5% service level) or the incident is not resolved, review again and consider P3 or P1 for the evening."}
